_comment: Cloudflare Cache Rules for ClinicX. Apply with: node scripts/apply-cloudflare-cache-rules.mjs. Phase: http_request_cache_settings. Rules are evaluated top-down; the first match wins, so order matters.

rules.description: Never cache dashboards, admin, auth, consults or API
rules.expression: (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/dashboard") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/auth") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/login") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/register") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/signup") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/onboarding") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/invite") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/consult") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_serverFn"))

rules.description: Never cache editor/template preview renders (per-editor state)
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.query contains "preview" or http.request.uri.query contains "tpl=" or http.request.uri.query contains "tc=")

rules.description: Booking + walk-in pages: very short edge TTL, serve stale while revalidating
rules.expression: (http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/c/") and (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/book") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/walkin")))

rules.description: Public clinic websites: cache hard at the edge, serve stale while revalidating
Marketing / SEO pages: 1h edge TTL, serve stale while revalidating
rules.expression: (http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and (http.request.uri.path eq "/" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/compare/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/clinic-software/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/for/") or http.request.uri.path in {"/about" "/features" "/services" "/faq" "/how-it-works" "/contact" "/privacy" "/terms" "/refund-policy" "/shipping-policy"}))

rules.description: Hashed build assets and static media: immutable
